newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT - DUTCH CHARTISTS UPBEAT ABOUT NEW AEX RECORD.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - DUTCH CHARTISTS UPBEAT ABOUT NEW AEX RECORD.

text.p: Dutch chartists said on Monday
that last week's technical break of the AEX index above 572.50
points has cleared the way to 600 points.
"We expect the AEX to reach even higher prices after a short
consolidation around 600, needed to let bulls take a breather,"
ABN AMRO said.
This bullish outlook was confirmed by increasing volumes.
"AEX money flow is at sky high levels," ING Barings said
The AEX index ended at 584.93 points on Friday, Oct 4, 13.01
points above the previous Friday. In the week before that the
index had gained 6.22 points.

Note - Contributors' own analysis follows.
ABN AMRO - Now that the AEX has succeeded to hold ground
above previous resistance at 572.50, the upward scenario with
603 as first target has been initiated. We expect the AEX to
reach for even higher prices after a short consolidation around
600, needed to let bulls take a breather. This bullish outlook
is being confirmed by increasing volumes. However, we expect
volatility to remain high and therefore we advise to maintain
close, trailing exit stops.
ING Barings - Last Monday's break above horizontal
resistance at 572.50 has triggered a durable buy signal as it
has been accompanied by high volume. It shows the upward
completion out of a large base formation. The short-term uptrend
has been resumed. First objectives are found at the upper
reaches of its rising trend channel at 590-595. AEX money flow
at sky high levels, illustrating that liquidity keeps pouring
into market after previous pile-up at sidelines. It also shows
that market players are buying the dips. The AEX advance/decline
line also at record highs, confirming strong leadership in
market.
Fibonacci Press - The market is stronger than expected as
the intermediate trend has already turned upwards. This is
likely to cause higher prices the rest of the year. Preliminary
target is 632 while the 589 level, which was expected since June
this year, has changed into an intermediate target. Expect mild
weakness into mid-October -- as long as 571 support is not
broken, higher prices are likely thereafter.
